description: Homematic IP flush-mounted 16A smart switch with integrated power measurement. This profile only models the switch's self-consumption because the connected load is measured by the device.
measure_description: Measured repeatedly using Powercalc average mode for 300 seconds with a 7.7W dummy load, then averaged. No difference was measured between the on and off standby power.
name: Switching Actuator and Meter (16A), Flush-Mount
